1.t: The Hour draws near; the moon is split in two.

2.t: Whenever the disbelievers see a sign, they turn away and say, ‘Same old sorcery!’

3.t: They reject the truth and follow their own desires––everything is recorded––

4.t: although warning tales that should have restrained them have come down to them––

5.t: farreaching wisdom––but these warnings do not help:

6.t: so [Prophet] turn away from them. On the Day the Summoner will summon them to a horrific event,

7.t: eyes downcast, they will come out of their graves like swarming locusts

8.t: rushing towards the Summoner. The disbelievers will cry, ‘This is a stern day!’

9.t: The people of Noah rejected the truth before them: they rejected Our servant, saying, ‘He is mad!’ Noah was rebuked,

10.t: and so he called upon his Lord, ‘I am defeated: help me!’

11.t: So We opened the gates of the sky with torrential water,

12.t: burst the earth with gushing springs: the waters met for a preordained purpose.

13.t: We carried him along on a vessel of planks and nails

14.t: that floated under Our watchful eye, a reward for the one who had been rejected.

15.t: We have left this as a sign: will anyone take heed?

16.t: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!

17.t: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?

18.t: The people of 'Ad also rejected the truth. How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!

19.t: We released a howling wind against them on a day of terrible disaster;

20.t: it swept people away like uprooted palm trunks.

21.t: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!

22.t: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?

23.t: The people of Thamud also rejected the warnings:

24.t: they said, ‘What? A man? Why should we follow a lone man from amongst ourselves? That would be misguided; quite insane!

25.t: Would a mes-sage be given to him alone out of all of us? No, he is an insolent liar!’

26.t: ‘Tomorrow they will know who is the insolent liar,

27.t: for We shall send them a she-camel to test them: so watch them [Salih] and be patient.

28.t: Tell them the water is to be shared between them: each one should drink in turn.’

29.t: But they called their companion, who took a sword and hamstrung the camel.

30.t: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!

31.t: We released a single mighty blast against them and they ended up like a fencemaker’s dry sticks.

32.t: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?

33.t: The people of Lot rejected the warnings.

34.t: We released a stonebearing wind against them, all except the family of Lot. We saved them before dawn

35.t: as a favour from Us: this is how We reward the thankful.

36.t: He warned them of Our onslaught, but they dismissed the warning-

37.t: they even demanded his guests from him- so We sealed their eyes- ‘ Taste My [terrible] punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!’-

38.t: and early in the morning a punishment seized them that still remains-

39.t: ‘Taste My [terrible] punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!’

40.t: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?

41.t: The people of Pharaoh also received warnings.

42.t: They rejected all Our signs so We seized them with all Our might and power.

43.t: ‘Are your disbelievers any better than these? Were you given an exemption in the Scripture?’

44.t: Do they perhaps say, ‘We are a great army and we shall be victorious’?

45.t: Their forces will be routed and they will turn tail and flee.

46.t: But the Hour is their appointed time- the Hour is more severe and bitter:

47.t: truly the wicked are misguided and quite insane––

48.t: on the Day when they are dragged on their faces in Hell. ‘Feel the touch of Hell.’

49.t: We have created all things in due measure;

50.t: when We ordain something it happens at once, in the blink of an eye;

51.t: We have destroyed the likes of you in the past. Will anyone take heed?

52.t: Everything they do is noted in their records:

53.t: every action, great or small, is recorded.

54.t: The righteous will live securely among Gardens and rivers,

55.t: secure in the presence of an all-powerful Sovereign.
